description: This Java source file defines the `MedicationDispense` class, which models detailed information about medication dispensing events in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes fields for patient data, encounter details, medication info, dispensing location, status, quantities, instructions, and substitution details, along with associated getters and setters.

classes.name: MedicationDispense
classes.description: Entity class representing medication dispensing events with detailed attributes and relationships to other entities such as Patient, Encounter, Concept, Drug, Location, Provider, and DrugOrder.
